extracted.intended_audience: UK consumers comparing or buying Sky TV streaming packages (Sky Ultimate TV / Sky Essential TV)
extracted.subtask_description: Information and terms for selecting between Sky Ultimate TV and Sky Essential TV, including included streaming apps, channel lineups, device and broadband requirements, pricing, add-ons, and contract/cancellation rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Included streaming apps and tiers (Ultimate TV)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Ultimate TV: Over £20 a month worth of streaming apps, with Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max, a taste of Hayu and discovery+.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specified included tiers: Disney+ Standard with Ads, HBO Max Basic with Ads, Netflix Standard with Ads and discovery+ Entertainment. To access each you may need to have or create an account and agree to that provider's terms and privacy policy. You can upgrade to paid tiers via Sky Marketplace (further terms apply).

rubrics_metrics.name: Included channels and pack contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Ultimate TV: 130+ channels, including Sky Atlantic, Sky One, Sky Docs, Sky Witness and more, includes 90 Free-to-air channels. Sky Essential TV: 100+ channels, Includes Sky Atlantic and 90 free-to-air channels. Netflix and discovery+ included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Package content lists which channels are in the base packs; additional TV packs (Sky Sports, Sky Cinema, Sky Kids, TNT Sports, Netflix add-ons, etc.) can be added at checkout. Some content/apps may only be available on compatible devices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing and minimum term
rubrics_metrics.description: From £24/month (Ultimate) / From £15/month (Essential). Prices may change during 24 month minimum term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different price options for new vs existing Sky customers and for 24-month minimum-term vs 31-day rolling subscriptions; rolling subscriptions auto-renew at the standard monthly rolling price. Exact current standard/rolling prices are noted in the text and may change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-existing third-party subscription handling
rubrics_metrics.description: You can link your existing subscriptions so you can keep watching without interruptions. For pre-existing services you may end up with two subscriptions if you don't manage existing accounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: If you currently pay for HBO Max, taking this service via Sky may result in two HBO Max subscriptions; to avoid this, manage your existing subscription before activating via Sky. Similar guidance applies for discovery+ and Paramount+.

rubrics_metrics.name: Device requirements: Sky Stream and Sky Glass
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Stream: TV streaming box plugs into your TV’s HDMI port and power supply. All you need is WiFi. Sky Glass: smart TV streams everything via your broadband connection. No dish or professional installation (except wall mount) required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sky Stream requires a TV with an HDMI port. Sky Glass must be set up in enhanced mode to use some features (Voice/Glance). Wall mounting Sky Glass requires a professional installer.

rubrics_metrics.name: General broadband speed requirements for Sky hardware/features
rubrics_metrics.description: All content on Sky Glass and Sky Stream is streamed via broadband, minimum speed of 25Mbps recommended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some features/packs have higher requirements: Whole Home and Ultra HD/Dolby packs require 30Mb/s minimum; additional 5Mb/s is required for each Sky Stream puck added to Whole Home.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum download speeds per streaming service
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommended minimum speeds per provider: Disney+ Standard with Ads / Disney+ Standard - 5 Mbps; HBO Max Basic with Ads / HBO Max Standard - 5 Mbps, HBO Max Premium - 50 Mbps; Netflix Standard with Ads - 3 Mb/s (per stream, HD), Netflix Standard - 5 Mb/s (HD), Netflix Premium - 25 Mb/s (Ultra HD); discovery+ - 5 Mb/s (and 20 Mb/s for 4K); Paramount+ - 2 Mb/s (and 25 Mb/s for 4K); Sky Go - 2Mb/s.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Speeds are 'recommended' minimums and vary by tier (ads vs no ads, HD vs Ultra HD). These are per-stream recommendations and affect viewing quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concurrent streams and service-specific device limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Netflix Standard with Ads included allows watching on two screens in HD. Netflix Standard Add-On - watch on 2 devices in HD (no ads). Netflix Premium Add-On - watch on 4 devices in Ultra HD (no ads). HBO Max and Disney+ included tiers allow two screens in HD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concurrent stream limits are governed by the included tier; upgrading via add-ons changes those limits. Third-party service terms also apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maximum Sky hardware per account
rubrics_metrics.description: Maximum of 3 Sky Glass TVs and 6 Sky Stream Pucks per account/household.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Whole Home subscription options exist to enable multi-device/home viewing; extra pucks after the first may have setup fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recording / PVR functionality limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Can I record TV on Sky TV? No, but you can save your favourites to a Playlist to watch later. Plus, you can pause live TV or rewind on a TV channel for up to 45 minutes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PVR functionality as traditionally understood (record-to-storage) isn't provided; short-term pause/rewind and Playlists are the replacements. The terms also note PVR functionality considerations in contract text for TV Essentials customers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Migration rules for existing Sky customers (Sky Q / Sky+)
rubrics_metrics.description: You can only have one Sky TV subscription at your address, so if you already have Sky Q or Sky+ you will need to end your current Sky TV subscription and take a new Sky Ultimate TV subscription. Recordings you have on Sky Q or Sky+ will not transfer to Sky Glass or Sky Stream puck. You will have to send back your Sky Q box(es) within 60 days of your Streaming TV cooling off period ending or you may incur a non-returns charge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Billing for existing Sky TV continues until the new subscription is activated; you will have to re-login to third-party apps; existing minimum terms on add-ons may require new minimum terms for equivalent add-ons on Streaming TV.

rubrics_metrics.name: Billing transfer behavior for Netflix
rubrics_metrics.description: For pre-existing Netflix customers taking Sky Essential TV or Ultimate TV subscriptions: your Netflix bill will automatically transfer from Netflix to Sky. If you cancel your Streaming TV subscription your Netflix subscription will continue, and your bill will automatically be transferred back from Sky to Netflix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This automatic bill transfer aims to avoid double billing, but customers should be aware of how account management changes when switching providers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add-on pricing, contract terms and cancellation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Add-ons have separate prices and may be subject to 24-month minimum terms (when taken with a 24-month Streaming TV minimum term) or be available on 31-day rolling subscriptions. Cancellation often requires 31 days' notice for rolling subscriptions; some add-ons are 'cancel anytime' but still require 31 days' notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Sky Cinema pricing differs between 24-month minimum term vs 31-day rolling; Sky Sports Complete price depends on whether taken with a minimum term. Read each add-on's terms for specifics and potential offers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ad Skipping pack specifics
rubrics_metrics.description: Ad Skipping: £6pm on a 31-day rolling subscription. Ad Skipping allows fast-forwarding through ads in on-demand content, including all Sky and paid Entertainment VOD, ITVX, and Channel 4 apps. Excludes Netflix. Cancel anytime. 31 days’ notice required to cancel. Requires Streaming TV subscription and Sky Glass or Sky Stream.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ad Skipping does not apply to Netflix content and requires eligible hardware and subscription; cancellation follows rolling-subscription notice rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whole Home subscription requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Whole Home: £15pm extra on a 31-day rolling subscription, to watch Sky TV on multiple compatible devices, with compatible HDMI port, in your home. Requires an additional Sky Glass TV or a Sky Stream puck (Set-up £0 first additional puck, £39.95 extra per puck thereafter) and broadband, min speed 30Mb/s. Additional 5Mb/s required for each Sky Stream puck added.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Whole Home enables multiple in-home devices but increases monthly cost and has setup fees for extra pucks beyond the first; also increases broadband requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ultra HD and Dolby Atmos pack requirements and limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Ultra HD and Dolby Atmos Pack: £6pm extra on a 31-day rolling subscription to watch Sky content in UHD/HDR and with Dolby Atmos. Requires broadband, min speed 30Mb/s. Dolby Digital Plus must be enabled in Settings to experience Dolby Atmos sound. Not all content available in UHD and/or HDR. 31 days’ notice to cancel. Offers may apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UHD/Atmos availability depends on content and device capabilities; enabling Dolby Atmos requires enabling Dolby Digital Plus in settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delivery, signature, and return conditions for Sky Glass / Stream
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Stream: Delivery by courier. Order by 9pm (Mon-Fri) or 3pm (Sunday) for next working day delivery (excludes Bank Holidays). Sky Glass: Delivery by courier; someone aged 18 or over will need to be home to sign for it. A £25 fee applies for returning Glass within the 31-day cooling off period, which will be added to your next bill.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different delivery options (Standard/Premium) may have charges; some installation/return actions have extra fees. Cooling-off period details and fees should be checked before returning hardware.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financing / Consumer Credit options for Sky Glass
rubrics_metrics.description: Options to purchase Sky Glass Gen 2 with a loan (Consumer Credit Agreement - CCA): Upfront fee £20. Sky UK Limited is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (Reference Number 712293) for consumer credit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If financing, customers should review the CCA terms, upfront fees and regulatory disclosures before agreeing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Energy efficiency ratings for Sky Glass Gen 2
rubrics_metrics.description: Energy efficiency ratings on a scale of A-G: 43" : Rated G; 55" : Rated E; 65" : Rated E.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ratings are provided for Gen 2 models and may affect energy consumption expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Store requirements and age restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Store: Available on Sky Glass and Sky Stream. Requires broadband minimum speeds: 2.5Mb/s (SD) and 5Mb/s (HD). See terms and conditions. UK and Ireland. 18+.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sky Store purchases and access have device and network minimums and age restrictions; full terms and conditions apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic availability and content/app restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain services and offers are restricted by geography: Sky Go is UK only; Sky Store and some offers are for UK and Ireland; other references mention Channel Islands and Isle of Man residential customers only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Availability of apps, promotions, and some content may vary by region and device compatibility; check regional terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotional offers and voucher redemption rules (Vue Cinema tickets)
rubrics_metrics.description: Promotion: Sky Cinema customers can claim up to two standard tickets per month, valid for showings from Sunday to Thursday. Voucher codes must be used within the same calendar month they are generated. Codes cannot be combined with other ticket offers; each voucher code is valid for one ticket only. Some exclusions (trial offers, NOW members, Virgin Media customers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Voucher redemptions are first-come, first-served and subject to daily limits; vouchers may expire at month-end and upgrades/additional fees at Vue apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing adjustments if existing add-on offers end mid-term
rubrics_metrics.description: If your current Sky Sports offer ends during your new minimum term, Sky Sports pricing of £33pm will apply for the remainder of your term. If your current Sky Cinema offer ends during your new minimum term, Sky Cinema pricing of £14pm will apply for the remainder of your term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When migrating or renewing, be aware that legacy promotional prices may revert to current package pricing mid-term if existing offers expire.
